# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Seed iteration (no priors). Diagnosed all 8 failing/flaky trajectories with read-only
subagents (one per cluster) + a subagent that read the actual scorer source
(`third_party/spreadsheetbench/evaluation/evaluation.py`) so every contract claim is
grounded in what the grader really compares.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials × recoverable score, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Cosmetic verify + identical resubmits | 47766, 52216, 250-20, 493-18, 54638 | agent reprints but never checks completeness/type/baseline; wastes rounds re-sending identical code | BEHAVIORAL | ordered checklist (structure) |
| 2 | pandas full-sheet round-trip corrupts file | 493-18, 250-20, 262-17 | `pd.read_excel`→`df.to_excel` injects `Unnamed:N` into blank headers, coerces text IDs to numbers, drops cells/sheets | CAPABILITY-GAP (method) | worked procedure |
| 3 | Malformed code fence → no execution | 48365 | model emitted `<\|tool_call\|>` wrapper instead of ```python fence; nothing ran, no output file | KNOWLEDGE/CONTRACT | worked example + recovery |
| 4 | Date/time written as a string | 32438 | `strftime` → text "18:08:00"; grader trims real time to "18:08" so text ≠ real time | KNOWLEDGE/CONTRACT | typed-value rule |
| 5 | Wrong sheet when answer_position has no "!" | 54638 | wrote Sheet2; grader defaults a no-sheet range to the FIRST sheet | KNOWLEDGE | sourced rule |
| 6 | Unstable sort reorders ties | 262-17 (flaky) | pandas default quicksort is not stable; Excel sorts are | KNOWLEDGE | sourced rule |

Scorer facts used (evaluation.py:18-47): numbers coerced to float & rounded to 2dp (so a
number stored as *text* actually MATCHES — not a real failure); a real `datetime.time` is
compared as `str(v)[:-3]` while a literal time string stays verbatim → genuine mismatch;
non-coercible strings compared by exact type+value; a no-`!` range defaults to
`sheetnames[0]`. These made edits 4 and 5 precise rather than guesses.

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | ordered checklist (structure) | task_template.md | Step 3 is now a precondition of finishing: print value+type for answer_position, confirm no empty/default cells, numbers/dates typed, baseline/extent sanity holds; forbid identical resubmits. Encodes the exact gaps that failed 5 traces. | 32902/48745 already verify & all cells filled → pass the checklist unchanged |
| 2 | worked procedure | prompt.md | "Edit in place with openpyxl; do NOT round-trip a whole sheet via pandas; if you must, use `header=None`/`header=False`." Removes the `Unnamed:N`, dtype-coercion and dropped-cell damage. | Explicitly endorses 48745's `header=None`+`header=False` pandas path and 32902's openpyxl-in-place path |
| 3 | worked example + recovery | task_template.md | Shows the exact ```python fence, bans `<tool_call>`/XML/`call:` wrappers, and states the recovery ("re-send same code fenced"). | passing traces already fence correctly → reinforced |
| 4 | typed-value rule | prompt.md | "Write dates/times as real datetime/time values, never strftime/str/TEXT." Scoped to dates/times (where the scorer genuinely mismatches text). | 48745 writes text group labels (not dates) and 32902 writes numbers → untouched; number-as-text left alone since scorer coerces it |
| 5 | sourced rule | prompt.md | "No sheet name in answer_position ⇒ first sheet; a named sheet ⇒ that exact sheet." Matches `sheetnames[0]` default in grader. | 32902/48745 are single-sheet/first-sheet already → no change |
| 6 | sourced rule | prompt.md | "Use a stable sort (`kind='mergesort'`) so tied rows keep order." | no passing task sorts |

Also added (prompt.md): keep original cell dtype (read ID/code columns `dtype=str`); "delete
rows" = remove-and-shift-up unless clearly blank; re-derive a key from data when a
lookup/filter collapses to empty/0 (fixes the wrong-guess half of 47766 & 52216).

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change: trace → what the edit changes on those inputs)
- 48365: every round was `<|tool_call|>...` → rejected unparsed, 0 output. New fence example +
  wrapper ban + "re-send same code fenced" → the (already-correct) solution code gets executed.
- 32438: agent wrote `df.dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')` strings (saw `dtype: object`, stopped). Rule
  "dates/times as real time values, never strftime" + verify step "dates are real date/time
  not strings" → writes `datetime.time`, which the grader trims to "18:08" and matches.
- 54638: wrote uniques to Sheet2; grader checks Sheet1 (first sheet, no `!`). Rule "no sheet ⇒
  first sheet" → writes to Sheet1 where the partial sample lives.
- 493-18: `pd.read_excel`→`df.to_excel` injected `Unnamed:3/4` into blank headers and blanked
  in place instead of shifting. "Edit in place with openpyxl / don't round-trip" + "delete =
  shift up" → header cells preserved and rows shifted.
- 250-20: pandas dtype-coerced text IDs and over-merged. "Keep original dtype / dtype=str" +
  verify "row count matches expected extent" → IDs stay text, over-merge caught at verify.
- 262-17: `sort_values` default quicksort reordered a tie block on copy 3. `kind='mergesort'`
  → tie order preserved on every copy, flaky→consistent.
- 47766: filtered to year 2023 from label cells M10/N10 while real dates are 2021 → sum ~0, no
  verify, 3 identical resubmits. Verify "filtered total not ~0 when many rows match" + "re-derive
  from actual data" + "never resubmit identical code" → catches the collapse and re-derives.
- 52216: bad dropdown guess left Electricity cells empty, no final verify. Verify "no cell left
  empty/0 from a failed lookup" + re-derive-key rule → catches the empty cells.

## Blast-radius per edit (class + passing tasks checked: 32902, 48745)
All six edits are BOUNDED/additive. None alters a global decision/permission/refusal rule.
- Edit 1 (checklist): additive precondition; both passing traces already verify and leave no
  empty cells → trajectory unchanged, they still finish after a passing verify.
- Edit 2 (openpyxl-in-place): the pandas safeguard explicitly names 48745's exact
  (`header=None`,`header=False`) path, and 32902 already edits in place → neither is pushed to
  a new approach.
- Edit 3 (fence): both already fence correctly.
- Edit 4 (typed dates): scoped to dates/times; 48745 writes strings-that-are-correct (group
  labels, not dates), 32902 writes numbers → neither matches the condition.
- Edit 5 (sheet default): both already on the first/only sheet.
- Edit 6 (stable sort): neither passing task sorts.

## Process & features used
- Subagents / parallel: YES — 5 read-only diagnostic subagents (one per cluster-group) + 1
  scorer-source reader, run in parallel; merged findings into this one candidate serially.
- Prior iterations: none (seed). RUNMAP/LEDGER/JOURNAL empty; rejected.jsonl & history.jsonl empty.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- openpyxl-in-place for Cell-Level numeric writes (32902) and pandas `header=None`/`header=False`
  for full-sheet text rewrites (48745) are both explicitly endorsed — do not forbid either.
- The scorer coerces numeric strings to float, so number-as-text is NOT a failure; never add a
  blanket "numbers must not be strings" rule (would waste words and risks over-coercion).

## Deliberately skipped
- No ENVIRONMENT fault found (48365 is a model output-format quirk, fixable via the fence
  example — not infra). All failures are capability/prose-addressable.
- 250-20 over-merge (the groupby collapses pairs the reference keeps separate) is partly a
  logic-ambiguity I can only nudge via the verify "row-count matches expected extent" check;
  did not hardcode its dedup criterion (would overfit).
